outputs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied five-person founding courtyard prototype. Produce a game-ready empty environment plate from this exact image. Remove ALL human figures everywhere (people at the main hall doorway, central stone plaza, left herb beds, left rice paddy, small right kitchen, right meditation terrace, front left field path), their carried tools and their cast shadows; reconstruct the small ground/door/background areas naturally. Preserve every building, all architecture, the ancient pine tree, main hall, front gate, sacred turquoise spring pond, stairs, bridges, paths, herb beds, cliffs, composition, lighting, colors, camera, and all geographic relationships pixel-aligned with the reference as closely as possible. The main hall is upper central, ancient pine behind-left, gate lower central, spring right of gate. All closed houses keep complete roofs and closed exterior walls. No new people, creatures, UI, labels, borders or text. Maintain the original wide 16:9 landscape framing and the highly detailed hand-painted Chinese xianxia style. This image will be the exact fixed 2D ground-and-architecture painting used by a Godot game; moving characters will be rendered separately. Return only the finished empty environmental plate.

Create a production game character animation sprite atlas on a truly transparent background. Chinese xianxia hand-painted 2D characters, fixed oblique top-down camera (about 35 degrees looking downward), style consistent with the provided founding courtyard painting. Exactly 8 columns and 8 rows, 64 separate character poses in equal square cells, no visible grid, labels or borders. Output large square image ideally 2048x2048. Each character must stay fully inside its own cell with generous transparent margins, no overlap. All feet near the same baseline inside each cell, consistent body scale. All poses complete full body, face/hair details clear, realistic adult proportions (not chibi), no cast ground shadows. All sprite cells on transparent alpha.
Rows 1–4: SAME male sect leader Shen Yan, slim young adult, distinct deep indigo/navy robe with restrained ivory collar and warm bronze belt, high tied black topknot, clean silhouette, no hat.
Rows 5–8: SAME female disciple Lu Zhiwei, slim young adult, distinct warm ochre cropped outer jacket over cream sleeves and dark teal practical trousers, low black braid/bun with small russet ribbon, no hat. Clearly different hair and clothing colors from the leader.
ROW 1 male: 8-frame smooth walking cycle facing down-right / toward viewer at three-quarter angle, alternating foot plants, bent knees, small sleeve and robe follow-through. Frame 1 and 5 opposite contact poses.
ROW 2 male: 8-frame smooth walking cycle facing up-right / away from viewer at three-quarter angle. Visible back. Same character/clothes/proportions.
ROW 3 male: 8-frame gardening hoe cycle: upright prepare, raise hoe, lean and lower, ground contact, pull, recover. Modest small wooden hoe, whole tool inside each cell.
ROW 4 male: 8 standing turning poses in this precise column order: front-right neutral; halfway front-to-side; full right side neutral; halfway side-to-back; back-right neutral; halfway back-to-side; full right side; halfway side-to-front. Feet grounded, no tools.
ROW 5 female: same walking-toward-viewer cycle as row 1, clearly female ochre costume.
ROW 6 female: same walking-away cycle as row 2.
ROW 7 female: 8-frame tending herbs by hand with a small low basket: stand, lean, reach, pluck, transfer to basket, recover; keep feet planted, clearly changing arm and torso poses. No oversized equipment.
ROW 8 female: same precise 8-column standing turn sequence as row 4.
Do not render any landscape, UI, captions or framing. Do not include the reference courtyard architecture in the atlas. Match its painterly detail, soft daytime lighting and restrained natural palette. Keep all 64 cells orderly and the poses consistent enough for frame animation.
